Whether existing accounts will be migrated to the new rules is unconfirmed.

payout_interval.text_en: [Purchased on or after 8 Oct 2026] On-Demand Payouts included on every Instant account (no fixed cycle). [Purchased before 8 Oct 2026 (old article)] Standard 7-day cycle (first payout 7 days after the first trade; announced 29 Jun 2026); On-Demand Payout is an add-on that still requires the consistency and 3% cushion conditions. Announced 5 Oct 2026 (official X; date/time per the submitter). The official help centre applies the new article to accounts purchased on or after 8 Oct 2026 and the old article (v2) to accounts purchased before 8 Oct 2026 (those keep the old-article rules). Whether existing accounts will be migrated to the new rules is unconfirmed.

special_rules.title: Volume-weighted average holding time
special_rules.text: Volume-weighted average holding time must be ≥2 minutes: sum(minutes × volume) ÷ total volume. Repeated funded trades ≤15 seconds have a separate HFT rule. Not a simple average or a two-minute minimum for every trade.

consistency.text_ja: 最大利益日÷純利益が15%以下。部分決済は最終決済日に計上。最大損失取引対最大利益取引/日の別ルールは公式相違あり。
consistency.text_en: Largest profit day ÷ total profit ≤15% (payout condition); partial closes count on the day the position is fully closed. The 15% rule appears in the official help articles for both purchases from 8 Oct 2026 and earlier purchases. The separate biggest-loss vs biggest-win rule was removed (announced 5 Oct 2026 on official X; date/time per the submitter). Purchases before 8 Oct 2026 also have 15% under the old article. Whether existing accounts will be migrated to the new rules is unconfirmed.

Announced 5 Oct 2026 (official X; date/time per the submitter). The official help centre applies the new article to accounts purchased on or after 8 Oct 2026 and the old article (v2) to accounts purchased before 8 Oct 2026 (those keep the old-article rules). Whether existing accounts will be migrated to the new rules is unconfirmed.
